nodes.label: Ajzen (1991) - Theory of Planned Behavior
nodes.rationale: Guides the design of social interaction features (Community Feed, social cheers) to cultivate normative green behaviors.

nodes.label: Deci & Ryan (2000) - Self-Determination Theory
nodes.rationale: Theoretical justification for decoupling intrinsic environmental motivation (Green Coins) from extrinsic academic reward (SAT Points) to prevent overjustification effect.

nodes.label: DeLone & McLean (2003) - D&M IS Success Model
nodes.norm_label: delone & mclean (2003) - d&m is success model
nodes.rationale: Guides evaluation of information quality (IPCC carbon data) and system quality (low latency, RLS security) in user adoption.

nodes.label: Goodhue & Thompson (1995) - Task-Technology Fit
nodes.rationale: Justifies dynamic adaptive mobile reporting forms and canvas client-side compression matching students' field context.

nodes.label: Hamari et al. (2014) - Gamification Literature Review
nodes.norm_label: hamari et al. (2014) - gamification literature review
nodes.rationale: Literature basis for gamification mechanics (badges, leaderboards) that sustain long-term engagement without degrading intrinsic motivation.

nodes.label: IPCC (2019) - Refinement Guidelines for AFOLU
nodes.rationale: Scientific foundation for tree biomass carbon sequestration factor (5.00 kg CO2e/sapling/semester).

nodes.label: Leal Filho et al. (2019) - SDG Campus Integration
nodes.norm_label: leal filho et al. (2019) - sdg campus integration
nodes.rationale: Underpins the university-level imperative to digitally document student contributions to United Nations Sustainable Development Goals.

nodes.label: WRI & WBCSD (2020) - GHG Protocol Scope 3 Standard
nodes.norm_label: wri & wbcsd (2020) - ghg protocol scope 3 standard
nodes.rationale: Global methodology for calculating avoided methane emissions from organic waste biopori holes (0.50 kg CO2e/hole/month).

nodes.label: Direct Activity Mapping
nodes.rationale: Replaces 50 GC -> 1 SAT arbitrary currency exchange with direct per-activity mapping approved by Admin/SSO.

nodes.label: Dual-Track Reward System
nodes.rationale: SSO and TFI regulations prohibit arbitrary coin conversion; academic SAT points and Comserv hours must be directly mapped to verified real actions, while Green Coins drive social gamification and BEKEN Award nominations.

nodes.label: Seamless Frictionless Reporting Flow
nodes.rationale: Reduces student reporting friction via instant QR banner access, @binus.ac.id registration, auto-mapping to TFI/SDG, dynamic forms, and digital content link attachments.

nodes.label: TFI Regulations Alignment
nodes.rationale: Enforces Teach For Indonesia community service regulations requiring physical verification, survey documentation, and community participation rather than arbitrary coin conversion.

nodes.label: Three-Branch Verifier Triage Decision Matrix
nodes.rationale: Optimizes review queue by triaging actions into Approve Full, Approve Coins Only, or Reject with Reason.

nodes.label: Super Admin Panel AdminLTE Implementation
nodes.rationale: Introduced an AdminLTE-style webview panel to fulfill user feedback for centralized administration and audit.

nodes.label: UI Simplification and Standalone Guide/FAQ Page
nodes.norm_label: ui simplification and standalone guide/faq page
nodes.rationale: Resolves information overload by expanding whitespace and dedicating a single page for guides and FAQs.

nodes.label: Zero-Cost Cloud Architecture
nodes.rationale: Removes multi-tier microservices and heavy workers, achieving $0 monthly cost using Netlify, Supabase, and Gemini 1.5 Flash free tiers with >85% buffer for limited pilot (~20 users/day).

nodes.label: Four-Quadrant Risk & Sustainability Matrix
nodes.rationale: Four-quadrant governance framework: data integrity (AI + perceptual hash), operational triage, regulatory compliance audit trails, and financial zero-cost sustainability.
